newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chinese Mercantile Bank sets US$20 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Chinese Mercantile Bank sets US$20 mln FRCD.

text.p: Chinese Mercantile Bank has launched a US$20 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue into general syndication, bankers said on Tuesday.
They said the facility has a final maturity of three years with annual put and call options. It was priced at par to float at 100 basis points over three-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
There is a put-option waiver fee of 40 basis points.
Management fees are 50 basis points for co-lead managers and 40 basis points for senior managers.
Cho Hung Finance and CS First Boston are arranging the transaction.

The deal is secured by financial covenants that state Hong Kong Chinese Bank, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China and China Travel Services Holdings Hongkong Ltd must maintain at least a 75 percent shareholding in the issuer.

According to the covenants, Hong Kong Chinese Bank and Industrial and Commercial Bank of China must retain at least a 50 percent shareholding in the issuer and must control the composition of the issuer's board of directors.
